name: qazmind
description: QazMind monorepo: QazMind Web (student and school), QazMind Admin, FastAPI backend (apps/api).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,admin --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
